question: The mode and median of a data set is 28.4 and 88, respectively. What is the mean of the data set? (Use empirical formula.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the empirical formula: Mean = (3 × Median − Mode) ÷ 2

⇒ Mean = (3 × 88 − 28.4) ÷ 2

⇒ Mean = (264 − 28.4) ÷ 2

⇒ Mean = 235.6 ÷ 2 = 117.8

**∴ The correct answer is 117.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode = 28.4

Median = 88

**Formula Used:**

Karl Pearson's Empirical Formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean</
